posts.title: Guest Designer Gaye
posts.description: Here's a wonderful card from Guest Designer Gaye. She made this lovely Fall themed religious card. How nice. If you made something that you would like to share, please send it to me at htondre@aol.com The store is open! I sell amazing lace, trims, embellishments and handmade items that I get in Turkiye. posts.title: Holidays of Horror
posts.description: Hello, Happy Saturday, usually I am sharing Thanksgiving and fall theme cards but today is Holiday of Horror downtown in Austin. How fun is that? What's crazy is I absolutely don't like actually Horror movies, it's that funny? I do love some campy or funny types, sometimes humerous. but I don't like being scared. I do love skulls though and I love the merch they sell, so I wanna see.... The store
